summary: Tested the new Cebraspe SEFAZ/AL 2026 home page (/ -> inicio.html) end to end: content, external-link removal, Fazer inscricao loader -> /termos.html, desktop menu -> loader -> /, acompanhamento -> /minhas-inscricoes.html, POST /api/track/access -> admin KPIs/accesses, and mobile layout + drawer at 360x780 (Android UA), 390x844 (iPhone UA) and 820x1180 (iPad UA). Everything requested works.

issues: Header is not sticky on mobile: after scrolling, the hamburger and logo are off-screen. This is optional; a sticky header would make the menu easier to reach on a long page.

57 links that went to external pages are now '#' and do nothing when clicked. Edital cards still look clickable (hover color/pointer). This is acceptable because the user wants no external navigation, but they could be made to look not clickable.
The .vc_row rows extend 15px past the viewport on each side (Bootstrap negative margins), but the extra width is hidden: scrollWidth == viewport and no horizontal scroll. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: The page loads one external resource: static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js. It is injected by the Cloudflare edge/proxy, not by the app. It causes no console errors and no navigation away.
The footer still shows the real Cebraspe address, phone and sac@cebraspe.org.br as plain text. There are no links, so this is OK for the no-external-links requirement.
Because of the Cloudflare beacon, page.goto with wait_until='networkidle' times out. Future tests should use wait_until='load'.
seed_data_creation: Created test access records via POST /api/track/access with visitor_id prefix TEST_ and user_agent containing TESTAGENT (these show up in admin accesses).
context_for_next_testing_agent: '/' serves the inicio.html content directly (no redirect stub in the response). No WebKit binary in this environment, so iOS was checked with Chromium using an iPhone viewport + UA. Drawer closes with the X button, a backdrop click and Escape. Loader is #home-loader.on; navigation happens after a 2s timeout. bfcache pageshow resets the loader (verified with go_back).
